impact.text: ETH sent to Core is stuck forever.

precondition_sources.text: The pool is initialized at tick 0 with liquidity.
The victim submits a swap with a sqrtRatioLimit set near the current price for slippage protection, with msg.value of 10 ether.

intent_sources.text: When ETH is sent via msg.value to Core during a swap, the debt accounting (_updatePairDebtWithNative) must be performed so the ETH is accounted for in the debt system.
